texts.li: [winter] Winter is the season for {ILLNESS}, and {A_nameDef} has it. The medicine shelf holds a few doses at most, and there are months of cold still to come. The council has to decide whether {A_nameDef} gets one of them now.

[child] {A_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} and lies in bed asking for {A_possessive} mother, or anyone. There are only a few doses of medicine left, and the grown-ups at the table have been very quiet about who should get them.
[afterraid] The raid used up most of the medicine, and now {A_nameDef} is down with {ILLNESS}. What's left on the shelf would treat {A_objective}, or the next person who comes home bleeding.

[trait:Kind] {A_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} and has told everyone not to waste the last of the medicine on {A_objective}. The person who has been sitting with {A_nameDef} at night disagrees, and has brought it to the council.

lines.li: [winter] The medicine stays on the shelf for the hard months ahead. {A_nameDef} has a bed by the hearth and a pot of broth, and has been told to stay in both.
[child] The medicine stays put. {A_nameDef} has a bed by the stove and someone reading to {A_objective} in the evenings, and is mending slowly.
[land:coast] {B_nameDef} came back from the rocks with salt-wet leaves and a root {B_pronoun} swore by. Boiled, it smelled of the sea and tasted worse. {A_nameDef} is breathing easier.
[land:tundra|land:boreal] {B_nameDef} found a patch of bitter moss under the pines and a handful of last year's berries. The tea was foul. {A_nameDef} drank it, and slept through the night for once.

texts.li: [winter] Everyone is shut in together for the winter, and {A_nameDef} has {ILLNESS}. The others are watching each cough the way they'd watch smoke under a door. They want {A_nameDef} moved somewhere apart, and {A_nameDef} wants to stay by the fire with everyone else.
[lowtech] The old ones say sickness travels on the breath, and they want {A_nameDef}, who has {ILLNESS}, out of the sleeping room until it's gone. {A_nameDef} says the old ones say a lot of things.

[small] There are only a few people in the colony, and {A_nameDef} is one of them, sick with {ILLNESS}. If it goes through everyone, nobody will be left on their feet to bring the water. Someone has suggested a bed apart.

lines.li: [winter] {A_nameDef} has a cot by a small fire of {A_possessive} own in the far room. The others bring food and leave it inside the door. {A_nameDef} talks to them through the wall at night.
[small] With only a handful of them, the council decided they're all in it together anyway. {A_nameDef} stays. The others wash their hands so often their knuckles are cracked.

texts.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} and won't leave the cooking fire. "Who else will tend it?" {A_nameDef} asked, between coughs into the smoke. The others have started taking their bowls to the far end of the hall.

[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} has {ILLNESS} and has not missed a single meal, and does not intend to. Some people think that's admirable. The people who have to eat the meals aren't sure.

lines.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} cooks with a wet cloth tied over {A_possessive} face and washes in the stream between meals. The food is as good as ever, and the people who were worried are eating slower.

texts.li: [winter] {B_nameDef} wants to bury {A_nameDef} up to the neck in a bed of warm ashes for a night, which is how {B_possessive} village treated {ILLNESS} in the cold months. {A_nameDef} hasn't said yes. {A_nameDef} hasn't said no.

[medieval] {B_nameDef} remembers how the cunning woman in {B_possessive} home village cured {ILLNESS}: a hot brick wrapped in flannel at the feet, a cup of elderflower and a word said over the bed. {B_nameDef} wants to try all three, and won't say what the word is.

[!lowtech] {B_nameDef} doesn't trust the medicine kit, and wants to treat {A_nameDef}'s {ILLNESS} the way {B_possessive} family always has: honey, hot whiskey and a scarf round the throat. {A_nameDef} is very interested in the whiskey.

lines.li: [medieval] {B_nameDef} did everything as the cunning woman did, word and all. In the morning {A_nameDef} was better, and {B_nameDef} still won't say what the word was.
[!lowtech] The honey and hot whiskey did something, though nobody can agree whether it was to the {ILLNESS} or to {A_nameDef}'s mood. {A_nameDef} is up and about.

texts.li: [winter] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came in from the snow coughing and has {THEIRILLNESS}. The road on from here is long and cold. {X_nameDef} asked {A_nameDef} whether the colony has any medicine to spare, and the colony has very little.

[colony:Generous] Word on the road is that this colony shares what it has, so {X_nameDef} of {FACTION}, who has {THEIRILLNESS}, came straight to {A_nameDef} and asked for medicine. There are a few doses left. Generosity has a limit, and the council has to find it.

[land:desert] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} says the cure for {ILLNESS} out here is to bury the sick to the chest in hot sand at noon and let the sun draw it out. {A_nameDef} looked at the sun, then at the sand, and asked for time to think.

[land:coast] {X_nameDef} says the sea cures {ILLNESS}: three dips in cold salt water at sunrise, then a bowl of fish broth with the heads left in. {A_nameDef} is sure about the broth and has doubts about the dips.

[x:old] {X_nameDef}, the oldest of the {FACTION} visitors, says {X_pronoun} has cured more cases of {ILLNESS} than the colony has people, with nothing but a hot stone, a cold cloth and a prayer to a saint nobody here has heard of.

lines.li: [land:desert] {A_nameDef} spent the noon hours buried to the chest in hot sand, with a wet cloth on {A_possessive} head and {X_nameDef} sitting beside {A_objective} telling stories. By evening the {ILLNESS} had eased.
[land:coast] Three cold dips at dawn and a bowl of fish-head broth, and {A_nameDef} was on {A_possessive} feet by the afternoon. {A_nameDef} refuses to say which part did it.

riskLines.li: [land:desert] {A_nameDef} sat in the hot sand all afternoon and came out sunburned and no better. {X_nameDef} says the sun was the wrong kind of sun.

texts.li: [rain] It has rained on the {FACTION} camp for three days, and now half of them are coughing. {X_nameDef} came to the colony soaked to the skin to ask {A_nameDef} for medicine, dry blankets, or both.

[theirHightech] {X_nameDef} of {FACTION} came over from the camp with an empty medical kit and a list of symptoms. Their supplies ran out a week ago, {X_nameDef} told {A_nameDef}, and the fever didn't.

[land:desert] Game is scarce in dry country at the best of times, and the {FACTION} camp has caught almost nothing. {X_nameDef} came to {A_nameDef} with an empty sack and asked if the colony could fill it.

[fall] The {FACTION} camp planned to live off the land through the fall, and the land has not cooperated. {X_nameDef} came to ask {A_nameDef} for food until the hunting picks up, and promised to pay it back in meat.

lines.li: [lowtech] The camp's people spent two days at the colony's woodpile with their own axes, and took home a sack of food each evening. The woodpile is taller than it has ever been.

texts.li: [rain|storm] A child from the {FACTION} camp ran off when the thunder started and hasn't come back. {X_nameDef} came through the rain to the colony's gate to ask for searchers before the light goes.

[land:mountains|land:hills] A child from the {FACTION} camp went up the slope after a goat and didn't come down. {X_nameDef} has been calling up the hillside since noon, and asked {A_nameDef} for people who know the paths.

[office:Speaker|office:Marshal|office:Quartermaster|office:Physician|office:Steward] {A_nameDef} holds a seat on the council and wasn't at the last meeting, because nobody fetched {A_objective} from the far end of the land. Things were decided in {A_possessive} name. {A_nameDef} would like a word about that.

[trait:Abrasive] {A_nameDef} missed the council meeting and has spent the morning telling everyone exactly what the council got wrong, and that {A_pronoun} would have said so if anyone had bothered to wait.

[winter] There's a sick bed in the colony and wood to chop every day, and {A_nameDef} has asked for a few days off. {A_nameDef} has been doing two people's work since the snow came, and has started to shake when {A_pronoun} lifts the axe.

[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} never asks for anything, which is why the council paid attention when {A_pronoun} asked for a few days off. The timing is bad. {A_nameDef} said so before anyone else could.

lines.li: [trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} took the days off and spent the first one trying to work anyway. On the second, {A_pronoun} gave up and slept until noon.

riskLines.li: [fall] {A_nameDef} went back out to the fields, and an hour later dropped {A_possessive} sickle in the furrow and walked away, and spent the rest of the day sitting alone under the trees.

texts.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} has carried water, cut wood and dug graves for this colony for longer than anyone. Today {A_nameDef} came to the council and set {A_possessive} spade against the wall. "Someone younger," {A_nameDef} said. {B_nameDef} is the someone younger the council has in mind.

[trait:Industrious|trait:HardWorker] {A_nameDef} has worked every day of {A_possessive} life and never complained. Yesterday {A_nameDef} sat down in the middle of a job and didn't get up again until supper. Today {A_pronoun} asked the council, haltingly, if {A_pronoun} might stop.

lines.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} sits on a stump by the work and tells {B_nameDef} what to do and what not to, the way {A_pronoun} was taught as a child. {B_nameDef} is getting good at it.

texts.li: [night] {A_nameDef} should have been asleep hours ago. Instead {A_nameDef} came to the council in {A_possessive} nightclothes and asked why the stars don't fall down, and whether anyone has ever been up there to check.
[grieving] {A_nameDef} wants to know why grown-ups cry when someone dies but won't talk about the person afterward. {A_nameDef} asked it plainly, at supper, and the table went quiet.

[lowtech] {A_nameDef} asked where the colony's tools come from: not who made them, but who made the first one, and how they made it without a tool. Nobody has a good answer, and {A_nameDef} has asked the council.

lines.li: [night] {A_nameDef} got a story about the stars instead of an answer, and fell asleep halfway through it. The council carried {A_objective} to bed.

texts.li: [land:coast] The tide left it on the rocks below the colony: a wooden box, sealed with wax, and inside a journal kept by someone of {FACTION} on a boat that never came back. {A_nameDef} has read the first page and stopped there.

[land:swamp|land:jungle] {A_nameDef} pulled a pack out of the mud where the marsh begins and found a journal in a waxed bag, kept by a traveler of {FACTION}. The pages are swollen and the ink has run, but most of it can still be read.

[lowtech] It has been the same pot of boiled grain and meat every day for longer than anyone can remember. {A_nameDef} turned {A_possessive} bowl upside down on the table at supper and asked the council, very politely, for anything else.

[!lowtech] {A_nameDef} has taken to carving a mark on the table leg for every day of the same meal. The table leg is running out of room. {A_nameDef} has asked the council for a change before it has to start on the second leg.

[large] There are more people in the colony than there were rooms built for them, and {A_nameDef} is the first to say it to the council's face. {A_nameDef} slept last night with someone's foot in {A_possessive} ear.
[newcomer] {A_nameDef} hasn't been here long and already knows the shape of everyone's elbows. {A_nameDef} asked the council, nervously, whether there's anywhere at all to be alone.

lines.li: [lowtech] {A_nameDef} carved a bowl from a block of soft wood, start to finish, with {B_nameDef} biting {B_possessive} tongue nearby. It's lopsided. {A_nameDef} eats every meal from it.
